description: This file defines the ModelField class, which models the <field> element of an entity in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for creating and managing entity field metadata, including attributes like name, type, column name, encryption, primary key status, validation, and XML serialization.

classes.name: ModelField
classes.description: An immutable class representing a database entity field, including metadata such as name, type, column mapping, encryption, validation, and audit logging options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ModelField with specified parameters, handling default values and immutability.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the field.

methods.name: getColName
methods.description: Returns the database column name for the field.

methods.name: getColValue
methods.description: Returns the column value if set; otherwise, defaults to the column name.

methods.name: getIsPk
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is part of the primary key.

methods.name: getIsNotNull
methods.description: Indicates whether the field cannot be null.

methods.name: getEncryptMethod
methods.description: Returns the encryption method used for the field.

methods.name: getEnableAuditLog
methods.description: Indicates if the field is included in audit logs.

methods.name: getIsAutoCreatedInternal
methods.description: Indicates if the field was auto-generated internally.

methods.name: getFieldSet
methods.description: Returns the name of the field set this field belongs to.

methods.name: getValidators
methods.description: Returns a list of validation rules for the field.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the field metadata to an XML Element.
